name: Shamii
source:
Airi's mascot character who gave her the power to become Lovely Lily. Has the power to restore her virginity whenever she's raped so she can continue to fight monsters without worry.

[spoiler]Truthfully Shamii is trying to send embarrassment energy back to his home planet and works with the Libido to put Airi in ever increasing embarrassing situations.[/spoiler]
